about_the_game:
Labyris Demo invites you into a surreal and psychological horror adventure set deep underground.

Carved in stone and bound by ancient rituals, the forgotten chambers beneath the earth hide unspeakable secrets. As you descend into the sealed dungeon where Jarduun was imprisoned, you will uncover the mysteries of a world twisted by fear and darkness.

In this demo, you will experience the core mechanics of Labyris:

- Atmospheric exploration through eerie, handcrafted environments

- Puzzle-solving elements that challenge your wit and perception

- Early combat encounters against horrifying creatures

- A first taste of the narrative that blends mythology, survival, and psychological tension

This demo is only a fragment of the full journey, but it is designed to showcase the mood, mechanics, and overall vision of the game. Every choice you make and every step you take will immerse you further into the nightmare.

Your feedback is invaluable — join us in shaping the world of Labyris. Thank you for being among the first to step into the darkness.

content_descriptors.notes: Labyris is a first-person psychological horror game featuring sustained tension, jump scares, occult themes, and disturbing ambience (dark labyrinths, ritual symbols, whispering voices). It includes non-graphic violence against demonic entities and occasional blood smears. There is no sexual content, no sexual assault/non-consensual sex, no nudity or BDSM. The game does not depict drug or alcohol abuse, nor self-harm. Scenes may trigger anxiety or claustrophobia.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580 (4 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD RX 5600 XT (6 GB VRAM or higher)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible

short_description: Labyris is a psychological horror adventure where you explore ancient stone chambers, solve puzzles, and face terrifying creatures. Descend into the sealed dungeon of Jarduun and experience a haunting blend of atmosphere, mystery, and survival.
